description: Fetch one product from any of twelve marketplaces by id or URL: price, rating, the full star histogram, specs, and the review text. `marketplace` picks the site — one of amazon, aliexpress, cdiscount, flipkart, mercadolibre, lazada, otto, rakuten, trendyol, jumia, vinted, temu. Costs 3 nooticr credits. Use for a single product; for a category or a competitive set, scan_marketplace_category collects many in one job and rolls them up.

domain.description: Amazon only: the marketplace host. Other sites use `market`.

id.description: The product id. Amazon: an ASIN or a full Amazon product URL · AliExpress: the numeric id from /item/<id>.html, or a full AliExpress product URL · Cdiscount: the SKU from a product URL's /f-<category>-<sku>.html, or the full URL · Flipkart: the 16-character PID from a product URL's pid= parameter, or the full URL · Mercado Libre: a site id such as MLA904253674, or a full Mercado Libre product URL · Lazada: the number after -i in a product URL (13711387806 in /products/<slug>-i13711387806.html), or the full URL · Otto: the tail of the product path — C1720803139 on otto.de, or the SKU AKLBB2029107352 on ottoversand.at · Rakuten: on Ichiba `<shopId>_<itemId>` (411453_10000003) or `<shop>/<manageNumber>`; on Taiwan `<shop>/<productCode>`. A full product URL works too · Trendyol: the number after -p- in a product URL (819066262 in /brand/name-p-819066262), or the full URL · Jumia: a SKU such as OR537EA86PWGTNAFAMZ. A product URL does NOT contain it — the number at the end of a product path is a different handle — so reach a product through `query` instead · Vinted: the numeric id from /items/<id>, or a full Vinted item URL · Temu: the goods id after -g- in a product URL, or the full URL

market.description: The storefront the product is on, for sites that have more than one. Amazon: a country code or host — com (US), co.uk, de, fr, it, es, ca, co.jp, in, com.br, com.mx, com.au, nl, se, pl, com.be, com.tr, ae, sa, eg, sg, cn. Default www.amazon.com · Mercado Libre: one of eighteen markets, named however it comes to hand — MLB, br, Brazil or mercadolivre.com.br. Inferred from the ids when omitted, and a job runs against one market: an id from another is refused rather than mis-filed · Lazada: sg, my, th, vn, ph or id. An item id is scoped to one of them — the same id on another Lazada host is a different product or nothing at all · Otto: de or at. The two are not interchangeable: an id from one does not address a product on the other · Rakuten: jp (Ichiba) or tw. Taiwan publishes no review text, so a category study there reads on price and rating alone · Trendyol: one of 47 storefronts — tr, de, ae, sa, at, be, fr, it, nl, pl, ro and the rest. An id is scoped to one: the same number 404s on another country's · Jumia: ng, eg, ke, ma, ci, gh, sn, tn, ug or dz · Vinted: one of 27 European storefronts — fr, de, es, it, pl, co.uk, com (US), com.au and the rest. A listing belongs to exactly one: the same item id does not exist on another country's Vinted · AliExpress, Cdiscount, Flipkart, Temu have one storefront each and take no market argument.

marketplace.description: Which site to read. One of: amazon, aliexpress, cdiscount, flipkart, mercadolibre, lazada, otto, rakuten, trendyol, jumia, vinted, temu.

url.description: The full product URL, if you have that instead.

name: get_marketplace_product

complete.description: False means more listings are still coming.

market.description: The storefront this ran against, however the site names it.

cached.description: true when the answer was served from the server's cache, at no cost.

charged.description: false when the call was refused before anything was debited.

nextCall.description: Set while the scan is still collecting: call this next, and write no conclusion until it is null.

product.description: The single product, also present as products[0].

reviewSummary.description: Amazon's own digest of the reviews.

reviewsGated.description: True when Amazon withheld the review bodies behind sign-in.

reviews.description: Every review across the scan, worst-rated first — the barriers are the half a summary drops.

groups.description: Brands (or sellers) holding the ratings counted.

priceIqr.description: Price spread; null with fewer than four prices.

top3SharePct.description: Share of the ratings held by the top three; null with fewer than three.

unitsAvailable.description: Always false: rating counts are not units sold.

competition.description: Competitive intensity from rating counts: concentration and price spread, never units or revenue.

rollup.description: The arithmetic over the set: price and rating spread, aspects by brand, 1-2 star share, competition.

scanId.description: Pass to amazon_scan_status to pick a running collection back up.

title: Get Marketplace Product
